1.zh: 大卫王年纪老迈，虽用被遮盖，仍不觉暖。
1.en: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

1.zh: 所以臣仆对他说：「不如为我主我王寻找一个处女，使她伺候王，奉养王，睡在王的怀中，好叫我主我王得暖。」
1.en: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

1.zh: 于是在以色列全境寻找美貌的童女，寻得书念的一个童女亚比煞，就带到王那里。
1.en: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

1.zh: 这童女极其美貌，她奉养王，伺候王，王却没有与她亲近。
1.en: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

1.zh: 那时，哈及的儿子亚多尼雅自尊，说：「我必作王」，就为自己预备车辆、马兵，又派五十人在他前头奔走。
1.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

1.zh: 他父亲素来没有使他忧闷，说：「你是做什么呢？」他甚俊美，生在押沙龙之后。
1.en: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

1.zh: 亚多尼雅与洗鲁雅的儿子约押，和祭司亚比亚他商议；二人就顺从他，帮助他。
1.en: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

1.zh: 但祭司撒督、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅、先知拿单、示每、利以，并大卫的勇士都不顺从亚多尼雅。
1.en: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

1.zh: 一日，亚多尼雅在隐·罗结旁、琐希列磐石那里宰了牛羊、肥犊，请他的诸弟兄，就是王的众子，并所有作王臣仆的犹大人；
1.en: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

1.zh: 惟独先知拿单和比拿雅并勇士，与他的兄弟所罗门，他都没有请。
1.en: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

1.zh: 拿单对所罗门的母亲拔示巴说：「哈及的儿子亚多尼雅作王了，你没有听见吗？我们的主大卫却不知道。
1.en: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

1.zh: 现在我可以给你出个主意，好保全你和你儿子所罗门的性命。
1.en: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

1.zh: 你进去见大卫王，对他说：『我主我王啊，你不曾向婢女起誓说：你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上吗？现在亚多尼雅怎么作了王呢？』
1.en: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

1.zh: 你还与王说话的时候，我也随后进去，证实你的话。」
1.en: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

1.zh: 拔示巴进入内室见王，王甚老迈，书念的童女亚比煞正伺候王。
1.en: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

1.zh: 拔示巴向王屈身下拜；王说：「你要什么？」
1.en: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

1.zh: 她说：「我主啊，你曾向婢女指着耶和华—你的　神起誓[说]：『你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上。』
1.en: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

1.zh: 现在亚多尼雅作王了，我主我王却不知道。
1.en: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

1.zh: 他宰了许多牛羊、肥犊，请了王的众子和祭司亚比亚他，并元帅约押；惟独王的仆人所罗门，他没有请。
1.en: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

1.zh: 我主我王啊，以色列众人的眼目都仰望你，等你晓谕他们，在我主我王之后谁坐你的位。
1.en: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

1.zh: 若不然，到我主我王与列祖同睡以后，我和我儿子所罗门必算为罪人了。」
1.en: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

1.zh: 拔示巴还与王说话的时候，先知拿单也进来了。
1.en: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

1.zh: 有人奏告王说：「先知拿单来了。」拿单进到王前，脸伏于地。
1.en: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

1.zh: 拿单说：「我主我王果然应许亚多尼雅说『你必接续我作王，坐在我的位上』吗？
1.en: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

1.zh: 他今日下去，宰了许多牛羊、肥犊，请了王的众子和军长，并祭司亚比亚他；他们正在亚多尼雅面前吃喝，说：『愿亚多尼雅王万岁！』
1.en: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

1.zh: 惟独我，就是你的仆人和祭司撒督，耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，并王的仆人所罗门，他都没有请。
1.en: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

1.zh: 这事果然出乎我主我王吗？王却没有告诉仆人们，在我主我王之后谁坐你的位。」
1.en: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

1.zh: 大卫王吩咐说：「叫拔示巴来。」拔示巴就进来，站在王面前。
1.en: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

1.zh: 王起誓说：「我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难、永生的耶和华起誓。
1.en: The king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

1.zh: 我既然指着耶和华—以色列的　神向你起誓说：你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上。我今日就必照这话而行。」
1.en: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

1.zh: 于是，拔示巴脸伏于地，向王下拜，说：「愿我主大卫王万岁！」
1.en: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

1.zh: 大卫王又吩咐说：「将祭司撒督、先知拿单、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅召来！」他们就都来到王面前。
1.en: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

1.zh: 王对他们说：「要带领你们主的仆人，使我儿子所罗门骑我的骡子，送他下到基训；
1.en: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

1.zh: 在那里，祭司撒督和先知拿单要膏他作以色列的王；你们也要吹角，说：『愿所罗门王万岁！』
1.en: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

1.zh: 然后要跟随他上来，使他坐在我的位上，接续我作王。我已立他作以色列和犹大的君。」
1.en: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

1.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅对王说：「阿们！愿耶和华—我主我王的　神也这样命定。
1.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.

1.zh: 耶和华怎样与我主我王同在，愿他照样与所罗门同在，使他的国位比我主大卫王的国位更大。」
1.en: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

1.zh: 于是，祭司撒督、先知拿单、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都下去使所罗门骑大卫王的骡子，将他送到基训。
1.en: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

1.zh: 祭司撒督就从帐幕中取了盛膏油的角来，用膏膏所罗门。人就吹角，众民都说：「愿所罗门王万岁！」
1.en: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

1.zh: 众民跟随他上来，且吹笛，大大欢呼，声音震地。
1.en: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

1.zh: 亚多尼雅和所请的众客筵宴方毕，听见这声音；约押听见角声就说：「城中为何有这响声呢？」
1.en: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

1.zh: 他正说话的时候，祭司亚比亚他的儿子约拿单来了。亚多尼雅对他说：「进来吧！你是个忠义的人，必是报好信息。」
1.en: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

1.zh: 约拿单对亚多尼雅说：「我们的主大卫王诚然立所罗门为王了。
1.en: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

1.zh: 王差遣祭司撒督、先知拿单、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都去使所罗门骑王的骡子。
1.en: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

1.zh: 祭司撒督和先知拿单在基训已经膏他作王。众人都从那里欢呼着上来，声音使城震动，这就是你们所听见的声音；
1.en: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

1.zh: 并且所罗门登了国位。
1.en: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

1.zh: 王的臣仆也来为我们的主大卫王祝福，说：『愿王的　神使所罗门的名比王的名更尊荣；使他的国位比王的国位更大。』王就在床上屈身下拜。
1.en: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

1.zh: 王又说：『耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的；因他赐我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也亲眼看见了。』」
1.en: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

1.zh: 亚多尼雅的众客[听见这话]就都惊惧，起来四散。
1.en: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

1.zh: 亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门，就起来，去抓住祭坛的角。
1.en: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.

1.zh: 有人告诉所罗门说：「亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门王，现在抓住祭坛的角，说：『愿所罗门王今日向我起誓，必不用刀杀仆人。』」
1.en: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”

1.zh: 所罗门说：「他若作忠义的人，连一根头发也不致落在地上；他若行恶，必要死亡。」
1.en: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

1.zh: 于是所罗门王差遣人，使亚多尼雅从坛上下来，他就来，向所罗门王下拜；所罗门对他说：「你回家去吧！」
1.en: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”

2.zh: 大卫的死期临近了，就嘱咐他儿子所罗门说：
2.en: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

2.zh: 「我现在要走世人必走的路。所以，你当刚强，作大丈夫，
2.en: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

2.zh: 遵守耶和华—你　神所吩咐的，照着摩西律法上所写的行主的道，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章、法度。这样，你无论做什么事，不拘往何处去，尽都亨通。
2.en: and keep the instruction of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.

2.zh: 耶和华必成就向我所应许的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，尽心尽意诚诚实实地行在我面前，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』
2.en: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’

2.zh: 你知道洗鲁雅的儿子约押向我所行的，就是杀了以色列的两个元帅：尼珥的儿子押尼珥和益帖的儿子亚玛撒。他在太平之时流这二人的血，如在争战之时一样，将这血染了腰间束的带和脚上穿的鞋。
2.en: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

2.zh: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白头安然下阴间。
2.en: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

2.zh: 你当恩待基列人巴西莱的众子，使他们常与你同席吃饭；因为我躲避你哥哥押沙龙的时候，他们[拿食物]来迎接我。
2.en: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

2.zh: 在你这里有巴户琳的便雅悯人，基拉的儿子示每；我往玛哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言语咒骂我，后来却下约旦河迎接我，我就指着耶和华向他起誓说：『我必不用刀杀你。』
2.en: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

2.zh: 现在你不要以他为无罪。你是聪明人，必知道怎样待他，使他白头见杀，流血下到阴间。」
2.en: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

2.zh: 大卫与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城。
2.en: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.

2.zh: 大卫作以色列王四十年：在希伯 作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
2.en: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

2.zh: 所罗门坐他父亲大卫的位，他的国甚是坚固。
2.en: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.

2.zh: 哈及的儿子亚多尼雅去见所罗门的母亲拔示巴，拔示巴问他说：「你来是为平安吗？」回答说：「是为平安」；
2.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.

2.zh: 又说：「我有话对你说。」拔示巴说：「你说吧。」
2.en: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”

2.zh: 亚多尼雅说：「你知道国原是归我的，以色列众人也都仰望我作王，不料，国反归了我兄弟，因他得国是出乎耶和华。
2.en: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the LORD.

2.zh: 现在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辞。」拔示巴说：「你说吧。」
2.en: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”

2.zh: 他说：「求你请所罗门王将书念的女子亚比煞赐我为妻，因他必不推辞你。」
2.en: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

2.zh: 拔示巴说：「好，我必为你对王提说。」
2.en: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”

2.zh: 于是，拔示巴去见所罗门王，要为亚多尼雅提说；王起来迎接，向她下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人为王母设一座位，她便坐在王的右边。
2.en: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

2.zh: 拔示巴说：「我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辞。」王说：「请母亲说，我必不推辞。」
2.en: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”

2.zh: 拔示巴说：「求你将书念的女子亚比煞赐给你哥哥亚多尼雅为妻。」
2.en: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”

2.zh: 所罗门王对他母亲说：「为何单替他求书念的女子亚比煞呢？也可以为他求国吧！他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亚比亚他和洗鲁雅的儿子约押[为辅佐]。」
2.en: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”

2.zh: 所罗门王就指着耶和华起誓说：「亚多尼雅这话是自己送命，不然，愿　神重重地降罚与我。
2.en: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

2.zh: 耶和华坚立我，使我坐在父亲大卫的位上，照着所应许的话为我建立家室；现在我指着永生的耶和华起誓，亚多尼雅今日必被治死。」
2.en: Now therefore as the LORD lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

2.zh: 于是所罗门王差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，将亚多尼雅杀死。
2.en: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

2.zh: 王对祭司亚比亚他说：「你回亚拿突归自己的田地去吧！你本是该死的，但因你在我父亲大卫面前抬过主耶和华的[约]柜，又与我父亲同受一切苦难，所以我今日不将你杀死。」
2.en: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord GOD’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

2.zh: 所罗门就革除亚比亚他，不许他作耶和华的祭司。这样，便应验耶和华在示罗论以利家所说的话。
2.en: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD, that he might fulfill the LORD’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

2.zh: 约押虽然没有归从押沙龙，却归从了亚多尼雅。他听见这风声，就逃到耶和华的帐幕，抓住祭坛的角。
2.en: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to the LORD’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

2.zh: 有人告诉所罗门王说：「约押逃到耶和华的帐幕，现今在祭坛的旁边。」所罗门就差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，说：「你去将他杀死。」
2.en: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to the LORD’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”

2.zh: 比拿雅来到耶和华的帐幕，对约押说：「王吩咐说，你出来吧！」他说：「我不出去，我要死在这里。」比拿雅就去回复王，说约押如此如此回答我。
2.en: Benaiah came to the LORD’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”

2.zh: 王说：「你可以照着他的话行，杀死他，将他葬埋，好叫约押流无辜人血的罪不归我和我的父家了。
2.en: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.

2.zh: 耶和华必使约押流人血的罪归到他自己的头上；因为他用刀杀了两个比他又义又好的人，就是以色列元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥和犹大元帅益帖的儿子亚玛撒，我父亲大卫却不知道。
2.en: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

2.zh: 故此，流这二人血的罪必归到约押和他后裔的头上，直到永远；惟有大卫和他的后裔，并他的家与国，必从耶和华那里得平安，直到永远。」
2.en: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from the LORD.”

2.zh: 于是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅上去，将约押杀死，葬在旷野约押自己的坟墓里。
2.en: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

2.zh: 王就立耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，代替约押，又使祭司撒督代替亚比亚他。
2.en: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

2.zh: 王差遣人将示每召来，对他说：「你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出来往别处去。
2.en: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.

2.zh: 你当确实地知道，你何日出来过汲沦溪，何日必死！你的罪必归到自己的头上。」
2.en: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

2.zh: 示每对王说：「这话甚好！我主我王怎样说，仆人必怎样行。」于是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。
2.en: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

2.zh: 过了三年，示每的两个仆人逃到迦特王玛迦的儿子亚吉那里去。有人告诉示每说：「你的仆人在迦特。」
2.en: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”

2.zh: 示每起来，备上驴，往迦特到亚吉那里去找他的仆人，就从迦特带他仆人回来。
2.en: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

2.zh: 有人告诉所罗门说：「示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回来了。」
2.en: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

2.zh: 王就差遣人将示每召了来，对他说：「我岂不是叫你指着耶和华起誓，并且警戒你说『你当确实地知道，你哪日出来往别处去，那日必死』吗？你也对我说：『这话甚好，我必听从。』
2.en: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by the LORD and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’

2.zh: 现在你为何不遵守你指着耶和华起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？」
2.en: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

2.zh: 王又对示每说：「你向我父亲大卫所行的一切恶事，你自己心里也知道，所以耶和华必使你的罪恶归到自己的头上；
2.en: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore the LORD will return your wickedness on your own head.

2.zh: 惟有所罗门王必得福，并且大卫的国位必在耶和华面前坚定，直到永远。」
2.en: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before the LORD forever.”

2.zh: 于是王吩咐耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，他就去杀死示每。这样，便坚定了所罗门的国位。
2.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

3.zh: 所罗门与埃及王法老结亲，娶了法老的女儿为妻，接她进入大卫城，直等到造完了自己的宫和耶和华的殿，并耶路撒冷周围的城墙。
3.en: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, the LORD’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

3.zh: 当那些日子，百姓仍在邱坛献祭，因为还没有为耶和华的名建殿。
3.en: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for the LORD’s name.

3.zh: 所罗门爱耶和华，遵行他父亲大卫的律例，只是还在邱坛献祭烧香。
3.en: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

3.zh: 所罗门王上基遍去献祭；因为在那里有极大的邱坛，他在那坛上献一千牺牲作燔祭。
3.en: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

3.zh: 在基遍，夜间梦中，耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：「你愿我赐你什么？你可以求。」
3.en: In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

3.zh: 所罗门说：「你仆人—我父亲大卫用诚实、公义、正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又为他存留大恩，赐他一个儿子坐在他的位上，正如今日一样。
3.en: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

3.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，如今你使仆人接续我父亲大卫作王；但我是幼童，不知道应当怎样出入。
3.en: Now, LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

3.zh: 仆人住在你所拣选的民中，这民多得不可胜数。
3.en: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

3.zh: 所以求你赐我智慧，可以判断你的民，能辨别是非。不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？」
3.en: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

3.zh: 所罗门因为求这事，就蒙主喜悦。
3.en: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

3.zh: 神对他说：「你既然求这事，不为自己求寿、求富，也不求灭绝你仇敌的性命，单求智慧可以听讼，
3.en: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

3.zh: 我就应允你所求的，赐你聪明智慧，甚至在你以前没有像你的，在你以后也没有像你的。
3.en: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

3.zh: 你所没有求的，我也赐给你，就是富足、尊荣，使你在世的日子，列王中没有一个能比你的。
3.en: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

3.zh: 你若效法你父亲大卫，遵行我的道，谨守我的律例、诫命，我必使你长寿。」
3.en: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”

3.zh: 所罗门醒了，不料是个梦。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和华的约柜前，献燔祭和平安祭，又为他众臣仆设摆筵席。
3.en: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

3.zh: 一日，有两个妓女来，站在王面前。
3.en: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.

3.zh: 一个说：「我主啊，我和这妇人同住一房；她在房中的时候，我生了一个男孩。
3.en: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

3.zh: 我生孩子后第三日，这妇人也生了孩子。我们是同住的，除了我们二人之外，房中再没有别人。
3.en: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

3.zh: 夜间，这妇人睡着的时候，压死了她的孩子。
3.en: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

3.zh: 她半夜起来，趁我睡着，从我旁边把我的孩子抱去，放在她怀里，将她的死孩子放在我怀里。
3.en: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

3.zh: 天要亮的时候，我起来要给我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了；及至天亮，我细细地察看，不是我所生的孩子。」
3.en: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”

3.zh: 那妇人说：「不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。」这妇人说：「不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。」她们在王面前如此争论。
3.en: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.

3.zh: 王说：「这妇人说『活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的』，那妇人说『不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的』」，
3.en: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”

3.zh: 就吩咐说：「拿刀来！」人就拿刀来。
3.en: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

3.zh: 王说：「将活孩子劈成两半，一半给那妇人，一半给这妇人。」
3.en: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

3.zh: 活孩子的母亲为自己的孩子心里急痛，就说：「求我主将活孩子给那妇人吧，万不可杀他！」那妇人说：「这孩子也不归我，也不归你，把他劈了吧！」
3.en: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”

3.zh: 王说：「将活孩子给这妇人，万不可杀他；这妇人实在是他的母亲。」
3.en: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

3.zh: 以色列众人听见王这样判断，就都敬畏他；因为见他心里有　神的智慧，能以断案。
3.en: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.

4.zh: 所罗门作以色列众人的王。
4.en: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

4.zh: 他的臣子记在下面：撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司，
4.en: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

4.zh: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈、亚希亚作书记，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
4.en: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

4.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，撒督和亚比亚他作祭司[长]，
4.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

4.zh: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作众吏长，王的朋友拿单的儿子撒布得作领袖，
4.en: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;

4.zh: 亚希煞作家宰，亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服苦的人。
4.en: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

4.zh: 所罗门在以色列全地立了十二个官吏，使他们供给王和王家的食物，每年各人供给一月。
4.en: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

4.zh: 他们的名字记在下面：在以法莲山地有便·户珥；
4.en: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

4.zh: 在玛迦斯、沙宾、伯·示麦、以伦·伯·哈南有便·底甲；
4.en: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

4.zh: 在亚鲁泊有便·希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
4.en: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

4.zh: 在多珥山冈有便·亚比拿达，他娶了所罗门的女儿她法为妻；
4.en: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

4.zh: 在他纳和米吉多，并靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下边的伯·善全地，从伯·善到亚伯·米何拉直到约念之外，有亚希律的儿子巴拿；
4.en: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

4.zh: 在基列的拉末有便·基别，他管理在基列的玛拿西子孙睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城墙和铜闩；
4.en: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

4.zh: 在玛哈念有易多的儿子亚希拿达；
4.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

4.zh: 在拿弗他利有亚希玛斯，他也娶了所罗门的一个女儿巴实抹为妻；
4.en: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

4.zh: 在亚设和亚禄有户筛的儿子巴拿；
4.en: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

4.zh: 在以萨迦有帕路亚的儿子约沙法；
4.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

4.zh: 在便雅悯有以拉的儿子示每；
4.en: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

4.zh: 在基列地，就是[从前属]亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有乌利的儿子基别一人管理。
4.en: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

4.zh: 犹大人和以色列人如同海边的沙那样多，都吃喝快乐。
4.en: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

4.zh: 所罗门统管诸国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。所罗门在世的日子，这些国都进贡服事他。
4.en: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

4.zh: 所罗门每日所用的食物：细面三十歌珥，粗面六十歌珥，
4.en: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

4.zh: 肥牛十只，草场的牛二十只，羊一百只，还有鹿、羚羊、狍子，并肥禽。
4.en: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

4.zh: 所罗门管理大河西边的诸王，以及从提弗萨直到迦萨的全地，四境尽都平安。
4.en: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

4.zh: 所罗门在世的日子，从但到别是巴的犹大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。
4.en: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

4.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四万，还有马兵一万二千。
4.en: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

4.zh: 那十二个官吏各按各月供给所罗门王，并一切与他同席之人的食物，一无所缺。
4.en: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

4.zh: 众人各按各分，将养马与快马的大麦和干草送到[官吏]那里。
4.en: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.

4.zh: 神赐给所罗门极大的智慧聪明和广大的心，如同海沙[不可测量]。
4.en: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

4.zh: 所罗门的智慧超过东方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
4.en: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

4.zh: 他的智慧胜过万人，胜过以斯拉人以探，并玛曷的儿子希幔、甲各、达大的智慧。他的名声传扬在四围的列国。
4.en: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

4.zh: 他作箴言三千句，诗歌一千零五首。
4.en: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

4.zh: 他讲论草木，自黎巴嫩的香柏树直到墙上长的牛膝草，又讲论飞禽走兽、昆虫水族。
4.en: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

4.zh: 天下列王听见所罗门的智慧，就都差人来听他的智慧话。
4.en: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

5.zh: 泰尔王希兰，平素爱大卫；他听见以色列人膏所罗门，接续他父亲作王，就差遣臣仆来见他。
5.en: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

5.zh: 所罗门也差遣人去见希兰，说：
「你知道我父亲大卫因四围的争战，不能为耶和华—他　神的名建殿，直等到耶和华使仇敌都服在他脚下。
5.en: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

5.zh: 现在耶和华—我的　神使我四围平安，没有仇敌，没有灾祸。
5.en: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

5.zh: 我定意要为耶和华—我　神的名建殿，是照耶和华应许我父亲大卫的话说：『我必使你儿子接续你坐你的位，他必为我的名建殿。』
5.en: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

5.zh: 所以求你吩咐你的仆人在黎巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木，我的仆人也必帮助他们，我必照你所定的，给你仆人的工价；因为你知道，在我们中间没有人像西顿人善于砍伐树木。」
5.en: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

5.zh: 希兰听见所罗门的话，就甚喜悦，说：「今日应当称颂耶和华；因他赐给大卫一个有智慧的儿子，治理这众多的民。」
5.en: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

5.zh: 希兰打发人去见所罗门，说：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都听见了；论到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心愿而行。
5.en: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

5.zh: 我的仆人必将这木料从黎巴嫩运到海里，扎成筏子，浮海运到你所指定我的地方，在那里拆开，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心愿，将食物给我的家。」
5.en: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

5.zh: 于是希兰照着所罗门所要的，给他香柏木和松木；
5.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

5.zh: 所罗门给希兰麦子二万歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所罗门每年都是这样给希兰。
5.en: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

5.zh: 耶和华照着所应许的赐智慧给所罗门。希兰与所罗门和好，彼此立约。
5.en: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

5.zh: 所罗门王从以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三万，
5.en: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

5.zh: 派他们轮流每月一万人上黎巴嫩去；一个月在黎巴嫩，两个月在家里。亚多尼兰掌管他们。
5.en: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

5.zh: 所罗门用七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的。
5.en: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

5.zh: 此外，所罗门用三千三百督工的，监管工人。
5.en: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

5.zh: 王下令，人就凿出又大又宝贵的石头来，用以立殿的根基。
5.en: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

5.zh: 所罗门的匠人和希兰的匠人，并迦巴勒人，都将石头凿好，预备木料和石头建殿。
5.en: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

6.zh: 以色列人出埃及地后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，开工建造耶和华的殿。
6.en: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.

6.zh: 所罗门王为耶和华所建的殿，长六十肘，宽二十肘，高三十肘。
6.en: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

6.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，阔十肘；
6.en: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

6.zh: 又为殿做了严紧的窗棂。
6.en: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

6.zh: 靠着殿墙，围着外殿内殿，造了三层旁屋；
6.en: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

6.zh: 下层宽五肘，中层宽六肘，上层宽七肘。殿外旁屋[的梁木]搁在殿墙坎上，免得插入殿墙。
6.en: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

6.zh: 建殿是用山中凿成的石头。建殿的时候，锤子、斧子，和别样铁器的响声都没有听见。
6.en: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

6.zh: 在殿右边当中的旁屋有门，门内有旋螺的楼梯，可以上到第二层，从第二层可以上到第三层。
6.en: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

6.zh: 所罗门建殿，安置香柏木的栋梁，又用香柏木板遮盖。
6.en: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

6.zh: 靠着殿所造的旁屋，每层高五肘，香柏木的栋梁搁在殿墙[坎上]。
6.en: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

6.zh: 耶和华的话临到所罗门说：
6.en: The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,

6.zh: 「论到你所建的这殿，你若遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，遵从我的一切诫命，我必向你应验我所应许你父亲大卫的话。
6.en: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

6.zh: 我必住在以色列人中间，并不丢弃我民以色列。」
6.en: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

6.zh: 所罗门建造殿宇。
6.en: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

6.zh: 殿里面用香柏木板贴墙，从地到棚顶都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板铺地。
6.en: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

6.zh: 内殿，就是至圣所，长二十肘，从地到[棚顶]用香柏木板遮蔽。
6.en: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

6.zh: 内殿前的外殿，长四十肘。
6.en: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

6.zh: 殿里一点石头都不显露，一概用香柏木遮蔽；上面刻着野瓜和初开的花。
6.en: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

6.zh: 殿里预备了内殿，好安放耶和华的约柜。
6.en: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.

6.zh: 内殿长二十肘，宽二十肘，高二十肘，墙面都贴上精金；又用香柏木做坛，包上精金。
6.en: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

6.zh: 所罗门用精金贴了殿内的墙，又用金链子挂在内殿前[门扇]，用金包裹。
6.en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

6.zh: 全殿都贴上金子，直到贴完；内殿前的坛，也都用金包裹。
6.en: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

6.zh: 他用橄榄木做两个基路伯，各高十肘，安在内殿。
6.en: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

6.zh: 这一个基路伯有两个翅膀，各长五肘，从这翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘；
6.en: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

6.zh: 那一个基路伯[的两个翅膀]也是十肘，两个基路伯的尺寸、形象都是一样。
6.en: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

6.zh: 这基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。
6.en: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

6.zh: 他将两个基路伯安在内殿里；基路伯的翅膀是张开的，这基路伯的一个翅膀挨着这边的墙，那基路伯的一个翅膀挨着那边的墙，里边的两个翅膀在殿中间彼此相接；
6.en: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

6.zh: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。
6.en: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

6.zh: 内殿、外殿周围的墙上都刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花。
6.en: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

6.zh: 内殿、外殿的地板都贴上金子。
6.en: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

6.zh: 又用橄榄木制造内殿的门扇、门楣、门框；门口[有墙的]五分之一。
6.en: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

6.zh: 在橄榄木做的两门扇上刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花，都贴上金子。
6.en: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

6.zh: 又用橄榄木制造外殿的门框，门口有[墙的]四分之一。
6.en: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

6.zh: 用松木做门两扇。这扇分两扇，是折叠的；那扇分两扇，也是折叠的。
6.en: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

6.zh: 上面刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花，都用金子贴了。
6.en: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

6.zh: 他又用凿成的石头三层、香柏木一层建筑内院。
6.en: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

6.zh: [所罗门 在位]第四年西弗月，立了耶和华殿的根基。
6.en: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

6.zh: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切属殿的都按着样式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。
6.en: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

7.zh: 所罗门为自己建造宫室，十三年方才造成；
7.en: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

7.zh: 又建造黎巴嫩林宫，长一百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三行，柱上有香柏木柁梁。
7.en: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

7.zh: 其上以香柏木为盖，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。
7.en: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

7.zh: 有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。
7.en: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

7.zh: 所有的门框都是厚木见方的，有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。
7.en: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

7.zh: 并建造有柱子的廊子，长五十肘，宽三十肘；在这廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和台阶。
7.en: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

7.zh: 又建造一廊，其中设立审判的座位，这廊从地到顶都用香柏木遮蔽。
7.en: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

7.zh: 廊后院内有所罗门住的宫室；工作与这工作相同。所罗门又为所娶法老的女儿建造一宫，做法与这廊子一样。
7.en: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

7.zh: 建造这一切所用的石头都是宝贵的，是按着尺寸凿成的，是用锯里外锯齐的；从根基直到檐石，从外头直到大院，都是如此。
7.en: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

7.zh: 根基是宝贵的大石头，有长十肘的，有长八肘的；
7.en: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

7.zh: 上面有香柏木和按着尺寸凿成宝贵的石头。
7.en: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

7.zh: 大院周围有凿成的石头三层、香柏木一层，都照耶和华殿的内院和殿廊的样式。
7.en: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.

7.zh: 所罗门王差遣人往泰尔去，将户兰召了来。
7.en: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

7.zh: 他是拿弗他利支派中一个寡妇的儿子，他父亲是泰尔人，作铜匠的。户兰满有智慧、聪明、技能，善于各样铜作。他来到所罗门王那里，做王一切所要做的。
7.en: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

7.zh: 他制造两根铜柱，每根高十八肘，围十二肘；
7.en: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

7.zh: 又用铜铸了两个柱顶安在柱上，各高五肘。
7.en: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

7.zh: 柱顶上有装修的网子和拧成的链索，每顶七个。
7.en: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

7.zh: 网子周围有两行[石榴]遮盖柱顶，两个柱顶都是如此。
7.en: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

7.zh: 廊子的柱顶径四肘，刻着百合花。
7.en: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

7.zh: 两柱顶的鼓肚上挨着网子，各有两行石榴环绕，两行共有二百。
7.en: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

7.zh: 他将两根柱子立在殿廊前头：右边立一根，起名叫雅斤；左边立一根，起名叫波阿斯。
7.en: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

7.zh: 在柱顶上刻着百合花。这样，造柱子的工就完毕了。
7.en: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

7.zh: 他又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘。
7.en: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

7.zh: 在海边之下，周围有野瓜的样式；每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的。
7.en: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

7.zh: 有十二只[铜]牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾都向内。
7.en: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

7.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容二千罢特。
7.en: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

7.zh: 他用铜制造十个[盆]座，每座长四肘，宽四肘，高三肘。
7.en: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

7.zh: 座的造法是这样：四面都有心子，心子在边子当中，
7.en: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

7.zh: 心子上有狮子和牛，并基路伯；边上有[小]座，狮子和牛以下有垂下的璎珞。
7.en: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

7.zh: 每[盆]座有四个铜轮和铜轴。[小]座的四角上在盆以下，有铸成的盆架，其旁都有璎珞。
7.en: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

7.zh: 小座高一肘，口是圆的，仿佛座的样式，[径]一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圆的。
7.en: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

7.zh: 四个轮子在心子以下，轮轴与座相连，每轮高一肘半。
7.en: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

7.zh: 轮的样式如同车轮；轴、辋、辐、毂都是铸的。
7.en: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

7.zh: 每座四角上都有盆架，是与座一同铸成的。
7.en: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

7.zh: 座上有圆架，高半肘；座上有撑子和心子，是与座一同铸的。
7.en: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

7.zh: 在撑子和心子上刻着基路伯、狮子，和棕树，周围有璎珞。
7.en: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

7.zh: 十个盆座都是这样，铸法、尺寸、样式相同。
7.en: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

7.zh: 又用铜制造十个盆，每盆可容四十罢特。盆径四肘，在那十座上，每座安设一盆。
7.en: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

7.zh: 五个安在殿门的右边，五个放在殿[门]的左边；又将海放在殿[门]的右旁，就是南边。
7.en: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.

7.zh: 户兰又造了盆、铲子，和盘子。这样，他为所罗门王做完了耶和华殿的一切工。
7.en: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD’s house:

7.zh: 所[造的]就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶；并两个盖柱顶的网子；
7.en: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

7.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上，每网两行，盖着两个柱上如球的顶；
7.en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

7.zh: 十个座和其上的十个盆；
7.en: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

7.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛；
7.en: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

7.zh: 盆、铲子、盘子。这一切都是户兰给所罗门王用光亮的铜为耶和华的殿造成的，
7.en: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for the LORD’s house, were of burnished bronze.

7.zh: 是[遵]王[命]在约旦平原、疏割和撒拉但中间借胶泥铸成的。
7.en: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

7.zh: 这一切所罗门都没有[过秤]；因为甚多，铜的轻重也无法可查。
7.en: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

7.zh: 所罗门又造耶和华殿里的金坛和陈设饼的金桌子；
7.en: Solomon made all the vessels that were in the LORD’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

7.zh: 内殿前的精金灯台：右边五个，左边五个，并其上的金花、灯盏、蜡剪，
7.en: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

7.zh: 与精金的杯、盘、镊子、调羹、火鼎，以及至圣所、内殿的门枢，和外殿的门枢。
7.en: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

7.zh: 所罗门王做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来放在耶和华殿的府库里。
7.en: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of the LORD’s house.

8.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老和各支派的首领，并以色列的族长，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城—就是锡安—运上来。
8.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

8.zh: 以他念月，就是七月，在节前，以色列人都聚集到所罗门王那里。
8.en: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

8.zh: 以色列长老来到，祭司便抬起[约]柜，
8.en: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

8.zh: 祭司和利未人将耶和华的[约]柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。
8.en: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

8.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众，一同在[约]柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。
8.en: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

8.zh: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
8.en: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

8.zh: 基路伯张着翅膀在[约]柜之上，遮掩[约]柜和抬柜的杠。
8.en: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

8.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前的圣所可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。
8.en: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

8.zh: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及地后，耶和华与他们立约的时候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。
8.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

8.zh: 祭司从圣所出来的时候，有云充满耶和华的殿；
8.en: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,

8.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了殿。
8.en: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

8.zh: 那时所罗门说： 耶和华曾说， 他必住在幽暗之处。
8.en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

8.zh: 我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。
8.en: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

8.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。
8.en: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

8.zh: 所罗门说：「耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。
8.en: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

8.zh: 他说：『自从我领我民以色列出埃及以来，我未曾在以色列各支派中选择一城建造殿宇—为我名的[居所]，但拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」
8.en: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

8.zh: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意，要为耶和华—以色列　神的名建殿。
8.en: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

8.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意为我的名建殿，这意思甚好。
8.en: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

8.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』
8.en: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

8.zh: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，又为耶和华—以色列　神的名建造了殿。
8.en: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

8.zh: 我也在其中为[约]柜预备一处。[约]柜内有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。」
8.en: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

8.zh: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，向天举手说：
8.en: Solomon stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

8.zh: 「耶和华—以色列的　神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；
8.en: and he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

8.zh: 向你仆人—我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。
8.en: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

8.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神啊，你所应许你仆人—我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，在我面前行事像你所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。
8.en: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

8.zh: 以色列的　神啊，求你成就向你仆人—我父大卫所应许的话。
8.en: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

8.zh: 「　神果真住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？
8.en: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

8.zh: 惟求耶和华—我的　神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人今日在你面前的祈祷呼吁。
8.en: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

8.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。
8.en: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

8.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你在天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
8.en: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

8.zh: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿在你的坛前起誓，
8.en: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

8.zh: 求你在天上垂听，判断你的仆人：定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。
8.en: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

8.zh: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里祈求祷告，
8.en: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

8.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们列祖之地。
8.en: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

8.zh: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨；他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
8.en: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

8.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人以色列民的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。
8.en: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

8.zh: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，
8.en: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

8.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉有罪，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，
8.en: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

8.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），
8.en: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

8.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。
8.en: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

8.zh: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你名从远方而来，
8.en: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

8.zh: （他们听人论说你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂）向这殿祷告，
8.en: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

8.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。
8.en: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

8.zh: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向耶和华所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
8.en: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to the LORD toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

8.zh: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
8.en: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

8.zh: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到仇敌之地，或远或近，
8.en: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

8.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；
8.en: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

8.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
8.en: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

8.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤；
8.en: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

8.zh: 饶恕得罪你的民，赦免他们的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜恤。
8.en: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

8.zh: 因为他们是你的子民，你的产业，是你从埃及领出来脱离铁炉的。
8.en: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

8.zh: 愿你的眼目看顾仆人，听你民以色列的祈求，无论何时向你祈求，愿你垂听。
8.en: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

8.zh: 主耶和华啊，你将他们从地上的万民中分别出来作你的产业，是照你领我们列祖出埃及的时候，借你仆人摩西所应许的话。」
8.en: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”

8.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛前屈膝跪着，向天举手，在耶和华面前祷告祈求已毕，就起来，
8.en: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

8.zh: 站着，大声为以色列全会众祝福，说：
8.en: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

8.zh: 「耶和华是应当称颂的！因为他照着一切所应许的赐平安给他的民以色列人，凡借他仆人摩西应许赐福的话，一句都没有落空。
8.en: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

8.zh: 愿耶和华—我们的　神与我们同在，像与我们列祖同在一样，不撇下我们，不丢弃我们，
8.en: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

8.zh: 使我们的心归向他，遵行他的道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命、律例、典章。
8.en: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

8.zh: 我在耶和华面前祈求的这些话，愿耶和华—我们的　神昼夜垂念，每日为他仆人与他民以色列伸冤，
8.en: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

8.zh: 使地上的万民都知道惟独耶和华是　神，并无别神。
8.en: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.

8.zh: 所以你们当向耶和华—我们的　神存诚实的心，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，[至终]如今日一样。」
8.en: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

8.zh: 王和以色列众民一同在耶和华面前献祭。
8.en: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

8.zh: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，用牛二万二千，羊十二万。这样，王和以色列众民为耶和华的殿行奉献之礼。
8.en: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.

8.zh: 当日，王因耶和华殿前的铜坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。
8.en: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

8.zh: 那时，所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成为大会，在耶和华—我们的　神面前守节七日又七日，共十四日。
8.en: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

8.zh: 第八日，王遣散众民；他们都为王祝福。因见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。
8.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

9.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，并一切所愿意建造的都完毕了，
9.en: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

9.zh: 耶和华就二次向所罗门显现，如先前在基遍向他显现一样，
9.en: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

9.zh: 对他说：「你向我所祷告祈求的，我都应允了。我已将你所建的这殿分别为圣，使我的名永远在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。
9.en: The LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

9.zh: 你若效法你父大卫，存诚实正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，
9.en: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

9.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位在以色列中，直到永远，正如我应许你父大卫说：『你[的子孙]必不断人坐以色列的国位。』
9.en: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

9.zh: 倘若你们和你们的子孙转去不跟从我，不守我指示你们的诫命律例，去事奉敬拜别神，
9.en: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

9.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上剪除，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使以色列人在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。
9.en: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

9.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶、嗤笑，说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』
9.en: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

9.zh: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃领他们列祖出埃及地之耶和华—他们的　神，去亲近别神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」
9.en: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them.’”

9.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，这两所二十年才完毕了。
9.en: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the LORD’s house and the king’s house

9.zh: 泰尔王希兰曾照所罗门所要的，资助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所罗门王就把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。
9.en: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

9.zh: 希兰从泰尔出来，察看所罗门给他的城邑，就不喜悦，
9.en: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

9.zh: 说：「我兄啊，你给我的是什么城邑呢？」他就给这城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
9.en: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

9.zh: 希兰给所罗门一百二十他连得金子。
9.en: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

9.zh: 所罗门王挑取服苦的人，是为建造耶和华的殿、自己的宫、米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、夏琐、米吉多，并基 色。
9.en: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

9.zh: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，用火焚烧，杀了城内居住的迦南人，将城赐给他女儿所罗门的妻作妆奁。
9.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

9.zh: 所罗门建造基色、下伯·和 、
9.en: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

9.zh: 巴拉，并国中旷野里的达莫，
9.en: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

9.zh: 又建造所有的积货城，并屯车和马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿建造的。
9.en: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

9.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
9.en: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

9.zh: 就是以色列人不能灭尽的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。
9.en: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

9.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们作奴仆，乃是作他的战士、臣仆、统领、军长、车兵长、马兵长。
9.en: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

9.zh: 所罗门有五百五十督工的，监管工人。
9.en: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

9.zh: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到[所罗门]为她建造的宫里。那时，所罗门才建造米罗。
9.en: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

9.zh: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华所筑的坛上献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华面前[的坛上]烧香。这样，他建造殿的工程完毕了。
9.en: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

9.zh: 所罗门王在以东地红海边，靠近以禄的以旬·迦别制造船只。
9.en: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

9.zh: 希兰差遣他的仆人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，与所罗门的仆人一同坐船航海。
9.en: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

9.zh: 他们到了俄斐，从那里得了四百二十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。
9.en: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.

10.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门因耶和华之名所得的名声，就来要用难解的话试问所罗门。
10.en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

10.zh: 跟随她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门王，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。
10.en: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

10.zh: 所罗门王将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。
10.en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

10.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门大有智慧，和他所建造的宫室，
10.en: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

10.zh: 席上的珍馐美味，群臣分列而坐，仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰和酒政的[衣服装饰]，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍；
10.en: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

10.zh: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！
10.en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

10.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了才知道人所告诉我的还不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越过我所听见的风声。
10.en: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

10.zh: 你的臣子、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的！
10.en: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

10.zh: 耶和华—你的　神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐以色列的国位；因为他永远爱以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行义。」
10.en: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

10.zh: 于是，示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料，送给所罗门王。她送给王的香料，以后奉来的不再有这样多。
10.en: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

10.zh: 希兰的船只从俄斐运了金子来，又从俄斐运了许多檀香木和宝石来。
10.en: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

10.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做栏杆，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟。以后再没有这样的檀香木进国来，也没有人看见过，直到如今。
10.en: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

10.zh: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所罗门王都送给她，另外照自己的厚意馈送她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。
10.en: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

10.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得。
10.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

10.zh: 另外还有商人和杂族的诸王，与国中的省长[所进的金子]。
10.en: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

10.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
10.en: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

10.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三弥那，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。
10.en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

10.zh: 王用象牙制造一个宝座，用精金包裹。
10.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

10.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，座的后背是圆的，两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。
10.en: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

10.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。
10.en: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

10.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金子的。黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。
10.en: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

10.zh: 因为王有他施船只与希兰的船只一同航海，三年一次，装载金银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。
10.en: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

10.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。
10.en: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

10.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听　神赐给他智慧的话。
10.en: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

10.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。
10.en: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

10.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
10.en: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

10.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
10.en: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

10.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。
10.en: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

10.zh: 从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百[舍客勒]，马每匹一百五十[舍客勒]。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。
10.en: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

11.zh: 所罗门王在法老的女儿之外，又宠爱许多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亚扪女子、以东女子、西顿女子、赫人女子。
11.en: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

11.zh: 论到这些国的人，耶和华曾晓谕以色列人说：「你们不可与她们往来相通，因为她们必诱惑你们的心去随从她们的神。」所罗门却恋爱这些女子。
11.en: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

11.zh: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主；还有嫔三百。这些妃嫔诱惑他的心。
11.en: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

11.zh: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心去随从别神，不效法他父亲大卫诚诚实实地顺服耶和华—他的　神。
11.en: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.

11.zh: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯她录和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公。
11.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

11.zh: 所罗门行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不效法他父亲大卫专心顺从耶和华。
11.en: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.

11.zh: 所罗门为摩押可憎的神基抹和亚扪人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷对面的山上建筑邱[坛]。
11.en: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

11.zh: 他为那些向自己的神烧香献祭的外邦女子，就是他娶来的妃嫔也是这样行。
11.en: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

11.zh: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离向他两次显现的耶和华—以色列的　神。
11.en: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

11.zh: 耶和华曾吩咐他不可随从别神，他却没有遵守耶和华所吩咐的。
11.en: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.

11.zh: 所以耶和华对他说：「你既行了这事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的约和律例，我必将你的国夺回，赐给你的臣子。
11.en: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

11.zh: 然而，因你父亲大卫的缘故，我不在你活着的日子行这事，必从你儿子的手中将国夺回。
11.en: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

11.zh: 只是我不将全国夺回，要因我仆人大卫和我所选择的耶路撒冷，还留一支派给你的儿子。」
11.en: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

11.zh: 耶和华使以东人哈达兴起，作所罗门的敌人；他是以东王的后裔。
11.en: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

11.zh: 先前大卫攻击以东，元帅约押上去葬埋阵亡的人，将以东的男丁都杀了。
11.en: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

11.zh: 约押和以色列众人在以东住了六个月，直到将以东的男丁尽都剪除。
11.en: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

11.zh: 那时哈达还是幼童；他和他父亲的臣仆，几个以东人逃往埃及。
11.en: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

11.zh: 他们从米甸起行，到了巴兰；从巴兰带着几个人来到埃及见埃及王法老；法老为他派定粮食，又给他房屋田地。
11.en: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
