11.zh: 哈达在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老将王后答比匿的妹子赐他为妻。
11.en: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

11.zh: 答比匿的妹子给哈达生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宫里断奶，基努拔就与法老的众子一同住在法老的宫里。
11.en: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

11.zh: 哈达在埃及听见大卫与他列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，就对法老说：「求王容我回本国去。」
11.en: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

11.zh: 法老对他说：「你在我这里有什么缺乏，你竟要回你本国去呢？」他回答说：「我没有缺乏什么，只是求王容我回去。」
11.en: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

11.zh: 神又使以利亚大的儿子利逊兴起，作所罗门的敌人。他先前逃避主人琐巴王哈大底谢。
11.en: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

11.zh: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一群人，自己作他们的头目，往大马士革居住，在那里作王。
11.en: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

11.zh: 所罗门活着的时候，哈达为患之外，利逊也作以色列的敌人。他恨恶以色列人，且作了亚兰人的王。
11.en: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

11.zh: 所罗门的臣仆、尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是以法莲支派的洗利达人，他母亲是寡妇，名叫洗鲁阿。
11.en: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

11.zh: 他举手攻击王的缘故，乃由先前所罗门建造米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口。
11.en: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

11.zh: 耶罗波安是大有才能的人。所罗门见这少年人殷勤，就派他监管约瑟家的一切工程。
11.en: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

11.zh: 一日，耶罗波安出了耶路撒冷，示罗人先知亚希雅在路上遇见他；[亚希雅]身上穿着一件新衣。他们二人在田野，以外并无别人。
11.en: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

11.zh: 亚希雅将自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，
11.en: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

11.zh: 对耶罗波安说：「你可以拿十片。耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『我必将国从所罗门手里夺回，将十个支派赐给你。（
11.en: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

11.zh: 我因仆人大卫和我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷城的缘故，仍给所罗门留一个支派。）
11.en: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

11.zh: 因为他离弃我，敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯她录、摩押的神基抹，和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵从我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，[守]我的律例典章，像他父亲大卫一样。
11.en: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

11.zh: 但我不从他手里将全国夺回；使他终身为君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守我的诫命律例。
11.en: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

11.zh: 我必从他儿子的手里将国夺回，以十个支派赐给你，
11.en: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

11.zh: 还留一个支派给他的儿子，使我仆人大卫在我所选择立我名的耶路撒冷城里，在我面前长有灯光。
11.en: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

11.zh: 我必拣选你，使你照心里一切所愿的，作王治理以色列。
11.en: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

11.zh: 你若听从我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我仆人大卫所行的，我就与你同在，为你立坚固的家，像我为大卫所立的一样，将以色列人赐给你。
11.en: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

11.zh: 我必因所罗门所行的使大卫后裔受患难，但不至于永远。』」
11.en: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

11.zh: 所罗门因此想要杀耶罗波安。耶罗波安却起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那里，就住在埃及，直到所罗门死了。
11.en: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

11.zh: 所罗门其余的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都写在所罗门记上。
11.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

11.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
11.en: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

11.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。
11.en: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

12.zh: 罗波安往示剑去；因为以色列人都到了示剑要立他作王。
12.en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

12.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里（他听见这事。）
12.en: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

12.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他来，他就和以色列会众都来见罗波安，对他说：
12.en: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

12.zh: 「你父亲使我们负重轭，[做苦工]，现在求你使我们做的苦工、负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」
12.en: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

12.zh: 罗波安对他们说：「你们暂且去，第三日再来见我。」民就去了。
12.en: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

12.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」
12.en: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

12.zh: 老年人对他说：「现在王若服事这民如仆人，用好话回答他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」
12.en: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

12.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，
12.en: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

12.zh: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」
12.en: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

12.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指头比我父亲的腰还粗。
12.en: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

12.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子[鞭]责打你们！』」
12.en: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

12.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。
12.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

12.zh: 王用严厉的话回答百姓，不用老年人给他所出的主意，
12.en: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

12.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对民说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子[鞭]责打你们！」
12.en: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

12.zh: 王不肯依从百姓，这事乃出于耶和华，为要应验他借示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
12.en: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

12.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列人都回自己家里去了，
12.en: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

12.zh: 惟独住犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。
12.en: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

12.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
12.en: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

12.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。
12.en: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

12.zh: 以色列众人听见耶罗波安回来了，就打发人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列众人的王。除了犹大支派以外，没有顺从大卫家的。
12.en: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

12.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大全家和便雅悯支派的人共十八万，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列家争战，好将国夺回，再归所罗门的儿子罗波安。
12.en: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

12.zh: 但　神的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
12.en: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

12.zh: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和犹大、便雅悯全家，并其余的民说：
12.en: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

12.zh: 『耶和华如此说：你们不可上去与你们的弟兄以色列人争战。各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话，遵着耶和华的命回去了。
12.en: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.

12.zh: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地建筑示剑，就住在其中；又从示剑出去，建筑毗努伊勒。
12.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

12.zh: 耶罗波安心里说：「恐怕这国仍归大卫家；
12.en: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

12.zh: 这民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和华的殿里献祭，他们的心必归向他们的主—犹大王罗波安，就把我杀了，仍归犹大王罗波安。」
12.en: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

12.zh: [耶罗波安]王就筹划定妥，铸造了两个金牛犊，对众民说：「以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在是难；这就是领你们出埃及地的神。」
12.en: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

12.zh: 他就把牛犊一只安在伯特利，一只安在但。
12.en: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

12.zh: 这事叫百姓陷在罪里，因为他们往但去[拜那牛犊]。
12.en: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

12.zh: 耶罗波安在邱坛那里建殿，将那不属利未人的凡民立为祭司。
12.en: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

12.zh: 耶罗波安定八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，自己上坛[献祭]。他在伯特利也这样向他所铸的牛犊献祭，又将立为邱坛的祭司安置在伯特利。
12.en: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

12.zh: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，为以色列人立作节期的日子，在伯特利上坛烧香。
12.en: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

13.zh: 那时，有一个神人奉耶和华的命从犹大来到伯特利。耶罗波安正站在坛旁要烧香；
13.en: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

13.zh: 神人奉耶和华的命向坛呼叫，说：「坛哪，坛哪！耶和华如此说：大卫家里必生一个儿子，名叫约西亚，他必将邱坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，杀在你上面，人的骨头也必烧在你上面。」
13.en: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

13.zh: 当日，神人设个预兆，说：「这坛必破裂，坛上的灰必倾撒，这是耶和华说的预兆。」
13.en: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

13.zh: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的坛所呼叫的话，就从坛上伸手，说：「拿住他吧！」王向神人所伸的手就枯干了，不能弯回；
13.en: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

13.zh: 坛也破裂了，坛上的灰倾撒了，正如神人奉耶和华的命所设的预兆。
13.en: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.

13.zh: 王对神人说：「请你为我祷告，求耶和华—你　神的恩典使我的手复原。」于是神人祈祷耶和华，王的手就复了原，仍如寻常一样。
13.en: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.

13.zh: 王对神人说：「请你同我回去[吃饭]，加添心力，我也必给你赏赐。」
13.en: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

13.zh: 神人对王说：「你就是把你的宫一半给我，我也不同你进去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水；
13.en: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

13.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我，说不可在伯特利吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。」
13.en: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

13.zh: 于是神人从别的路回去，不从伯特利来的原路回去。
13.en: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

13.zh: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他儿子们来，将神人当日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所说的话都告诉了父亲。
13.en: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

13.zh: 父亲问他们说：「神人从哪条路去了呢？」儿子们[就告诉他]；原来他们看见那从犹大来的神人所去的路。
13.en: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

13.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们备好了驴，他就骑上，
13.en: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

13.zh: 去追赶神人，遇见他坐在橡树底下，就问他说：「你是从犹大来的神人不是？」他说：「是。」
13.en: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

13.zh: 老先知对他说：「请你同我回家吃饭。」
13.en: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

13.zh: 神人说：「我不可同你回去进你的家，也不可在这里同你吃饭喝水；
13.en: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

13.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我说：『你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。』」
13.en: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

13.zh: 老先知对他说：「我也是先知，和你一样。有天使奉耶和华的命对我说：『你去把他带回你的家，叫他吃饭喝水。』」这都是老先知诓哄他。
13.en: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

13.zh: 于是神人同老先知回去，在他家里吃饭喝水。
13.en: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

13.zh: 二人坐席的时候，耶和华的话临到那带神人回来的先知，
13.en: As they sat at the table, the LORD’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

13.zh: 他就对那从犹大来的神人说：「耶和华如此说：你既违背耶和华的话，不遵守耶和华—你　神的命令，
13.en: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,

13.zh: 反倒回来，在耶和华禁止你吃饭喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的尸身不得入你列祖的坟墓。」
13.en: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

13.zh: 吃喝完了，老先知为所带回来的先知备驴。
13.en: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

13.zh: 他就去了，在路上有个狮子遇见他，将他咬死，尸身倒在路上，驴站在尸身旁边，狮子也站在尸身旁边。
13.en: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

13.zh: 有人从那里经过，看见尸身倒在路上，狮子站在尸身旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里述说这事。
13.en: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

13.zh: 那带神人回来的先知听见这事，就说：「这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人，所以耶和华把他交给狮子；狮子抓伤他，咬死他，是应验耶和华对他说的话。」
13.en: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”

13.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们就备了驴。
13.en: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

13.zh: 他去了，看见神人的尸身倒在路上，驴和狮子站在尸身旁边，狮子却没有吃尸身，也没有抓伤驴。
13.en: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

13.zh: 老先知就把神人的尸身驮在驴上，带回自己的城里，要哀哭他，葬埋他；
13.en: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

13.zh: 就把他的尸身葬在自己的坟墓里，哀哭他，[说]：「哀哉！我兄啊。」
13.en: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

13.zh: 安葬之后，老先知对他儿子们说：「我死了，你们要葬我在神人的坟墓里，使我的尸骨靠近他的尸骨，
13.en: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

13.zh: 因为他奉耶和华的命指着伯特利的坛和撒马利亚各城有邱坛之殿所说的话必定应验。」
13.en: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

13.zh: 这事以后，耶罗波安仍不离开他的恶道，将凡民立为邱坛的祭司；凡愿意的，他都分别为圣，立为邱坛的祭司。
13.en: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

13.zh: 这事叫耶罗波安的家陷在罪里，甚至他的家从地上除灭了。
13.en: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

14.zh: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。
14.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

14.zh: 耶罗波安对他的妻说：「你可以起来改装，使人不知道你是耶罗波安的妻，往示罗去，在那里有先知亚希雅。他曾告诉我说，你必作这民的王。
14.en: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

14.zh: 现在你要带十个饼，与几个薄饼，和一瓶蜜去见他，他必告诉你儿子将要怎样。」
14.en: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

14.zh: 耶罗波安的妻就这样行，起身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家。亚希雅因年纪老迈，眼目发直，不能看见。
14.en: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

14.zh: 耶和华先晓谕亚希雅说：「耶罗波安的妻要来问你，因她儿子病了，你当如此如此告诉她。她进来的时候必装作别的妇人。」
14.en: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

14.zh: 她刚进门，亚希雅听见她脚步的响声，就说：「耶罗波安的妻，进来吧！你为何装作别的妇人呢？我奉差遣将凶事告诉你。
14.en: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

14.zh: 你回去告诉耶罗波安[说]：『耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：我从民中将你高举，立你作我民以色列的君，
14.en: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

14.zh: 将国从大卫家夺回赐给你；你却不效法我仆人大卫，遵守我的诫命，一心顺从我，行我眼中看为正的事。
14.en: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

14.zh: 你竟行恶，比那在你以先的更甚，为自己立了别神，铸了偶像，惹我发怒，将我丢在背后。
14.en: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

14.zh: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家，将属耶罗波安的男丁，无论困住的、自由的都从以色列中剪除，必除尽耶罗波安的家，如人除尽粪土一般。
14.en: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

14.zh: 凡属耶罗波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。这是耶和华说的。』
14.en: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’

14.zh: 所以你起身回家去吧！你的脚一进城，你儿子就必死了。
14.en: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

14.zh: 以色列众人必为他哀哭，将他葬埋。凡属耶罗波安的人，惟有他得入坟墓；因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华—以色列的　神显出善行。
14.en: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

14.zh: 耶和华必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶罗波安的家；那日期已经到了。
14.en: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

14.zh: 耶和华必击打以色列人，使他们摇动，像水中的芦苇一般；又将他们从耶和华赐给他们列祖的美地上拔出来，分散在大河那边；因为他们做木偶，惹耶和华发怒。
14.en: For the LORD will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.

14.zh: 因耶罗波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪里，耶和华必将以色列人交给[仇敌]。」
14.en: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

14.zh: 耶罗波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，刚到门槛，儿子就死了。
14.en: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

14.zh: 以色列众人将他葬埋，为他哀哭，正如耶和华借他仆人先知亚希雅所说的话。
14.en: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

14.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王记上。
14.en: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

14.zh: 耶罗波安作王二十二年，就与他列祖同睡。他儿子拿答接续他作王。
14.en: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

14.zh: 所罗门的儿子罗波安作犹大王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
14.en: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

14.zh: 犹大人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，犯罪触动他的愤恨，比他们列祖更甚。
14.en: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

14.zh: 因为他们在各高冈上，各青翠树下筑坛，立柱像和木偶。
14.en: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

14.zh: 国中也有娈童。犹大人效法耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外邦人，行一切可憎恶的事。
14.en: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.

14.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，
14.en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

14.zh: 夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。
14.en: and he took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

14.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。
14.en: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

14.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。
14.en: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

14.zh: 罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。
14.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

14.zh: 罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。
14.en: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

14.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。他儿子亚比央接续他作王。
14.en: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王，
15.en: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

15.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
15.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

15.zh: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切恶，他的心不像他祖大卫的心，诚诚实实地顺服耶和华—他的　神。
15.en: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

15.zh: 然而耶和华—他的　神因大卫的缘故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有灯光，叫他儿子接续他作王，坚立耶路撒冷。
15.en: Nevertheless for David’s sake, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

15.zh: 因为大卫除 了赫人乌利亚那件事，都是行耶和 华眼中看为正的事，一生没有违背 耶和华一切所吩咐的。
15.en: because David did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

15.zh: 罗波安在 世的日子常与耶罗波安争战。
15.en: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

15.zh: 亚 比央其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。亚比央常与耶罗波安争战。
15.en: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

15.zh: 亚比央与他列祖同睡， 葬在大卫的城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。
15.en: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王，
15.en: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

15.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
15.en: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

15.zh: 亚撒效法他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，
15.en: Asa did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, as David his father did.

15.zh: 从国中除去娈童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；
15.en: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

15.zh: 并且贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，烧在汲沦溪边，
15.en: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

15.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去。亚撒一生却向耶和华存诚实的心。
15.en: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.

15.zh: 亚撒将他父亲所分别为圣与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到耶和华的殿里。
15.en: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

15.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。
15.en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

15.zh: 以色列王巴沙上来要攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。
15.en: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

15.zh: 于是亚撒将耶和华殿和王宫府库里所剩下的金银都交在他臣仆手中，打发他们往住大马士革的亚兰王—希旬的孙子、他伯利们的儿子便·哈达那里去，
15.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

15.zh: 说：「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送你为礼物，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」
15.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

15.zh: 便·哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑；他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯·伯·玛迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。
15.en: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

15.zh: 巴沙听见，就停工不修筑拉玛了，仍住在得撒。
15.en: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

15.zh: 于是亚撒王宣告犹大众人，不准一个推辞，吩咐他们将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。
15.en: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

15.zh: 亚撒其余的事，凡他所行的，并他的勇力与他所建筑的城邑，都写在犹大列王记上。亚撒年老的时候，脚上有病。
15.en: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

15.zh: 亚撒与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约沙法接续他作王。
15.en: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，
15.en: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

15.zh: 拿答行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行他父亲所行的，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

15.zh: 以萨迦人亚希雅的儿子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比顿杀了他。那时拿答和以色列众人正围困基比顿。
15.en: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

15.zh: 在犹大王亚撒第三年巴沙杀了他，篡了他的位。
15.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

15.zh: 巴沙一作王就杀了耶罗波安的全家，凡有气息的没有留下一个，都灭尽了，正应验耶和华借他仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话。
15.en: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

15.zh: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪里，惹动耶和华—以色列　神的怒气。
15.en: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.

15.zh: 拿答其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

15.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。
15.en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列众人的王共二十四年。
15.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

15.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

16.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子耶户，责备巴沙说：
16.en: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

16.zh: 「我既从尘埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶罗波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪里，惹我发怒，
16.en: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

16.zh: 我必除尽你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。
16.en: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

16.zh: 凡属巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。」
16.en: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

16.zh: 巴沙其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。
16.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

16.zh: 巴沙与他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他儿子以拉接续他作王。
16.en: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

16.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子先知耶户，责备巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和华眼中看为恶的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和华发怒，像耶罗波安的家一样，又因他杀了耶罗波安的全家。
16.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

16.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。
16.en: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

16.zh: 有管理他一半战车的臣子心利背叛他。当他在得撒家宰亚杂家里喝醉的时候，
16.en: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

16.zh: 心利就进去杀了他，篡了他的位。这是犹大王亚撒二十七年的事。
16.en: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

16.zh: 心利一坐王位就杀了巴沙的全家，连他的亲属、朋友也没有留下一个男丁。
16.en: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

16.zh: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，正如耶和华借先知耶户责备巴沙的话。
16.en: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

16.zh: 这是因巴沙和他儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无[的神]惹耶和华—以色列　神的怒气。
16.en: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

16.zh: 以拉其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。
16.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

16.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时民正安营围攻非利士的基比顿。
16.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

16.zh: 民在营中听说心利背叛，又杀了王，故此以色列众人当日在营中立元帅暗利作以色列王。
16.en: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

16.zh: 暗利率领以色列众人，从基比顿上去，围困得撒。
16.en: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

16.zh: 心利见城破失，就进了王宫的卫所，放火焚烧宫殿，自焚而死。
16.en: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

16.zh: 这是因他犯罪，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
16.en: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

16.zh: 心利其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。
16.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

16.zh: 那时，以色列民分为两半：一半随从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作 王；一半随从暗利。
16.en: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

16.zh: 但随从暗利的民胜过随从基纳的儿子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。
16.en: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

16.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。
16.en: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

16.zh: 暗利用二他连得银子向撒玛买了撒马利亚山，在山上造[城]，就按着山的原主撒玛的名，给所造的城起名叫撒马利亚。
16.en: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

16.zh: 暗利行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王作恶更甚。
16.en: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

16.zh: 因他行了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无[的神]惹耶和华—以色列　神的怒气。
16.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

16.zh: 暗利其余的事和他所显出的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
16.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

16.zh: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。
16.en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

16.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒马利亚作以色列王二十二年。
16.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

16.zh: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王更甚，
16.en: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.

16.zh: 犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪；他还以为轻，又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别为妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，
16.en: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

16.zh: 在撒马利亚建造巴力的庙，在庙里为巴力筑坛。
16.en: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

16.zh: 亚哈又做亚舍拉，他所行的惹耶和华—以色列　神的怒气，比他以前的以色列诸王更甚。
16.en: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

16.zh: 亚哈[在位]的时候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥[城]；立根基的时候，丧了长子亚比兰；安门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华借嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。
16.en: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

17.zh: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亚对亚哈说：「我指着所事奉永生耶和华—以色列的　神起誓，这几年我若不祷告，必不降露，不下雨。」
17.en: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

17.zh: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说：
17.en: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,

17.zh: 「你离开这里往东去，藏在约旦河东边的基立溪旁。
17.en: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

17.zh: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。」
17.en: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

17.zh: 于是以利亚照着耶和华的话，去住在约旦河东的基立溪旁。
17.en: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

17.zh: 乌鸦早晚给他叼饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。
17.en: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

17.zh: 过了些日子，溪水就干了，因为雨没有下在地上。
17.en: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

17.zh: 耶和华的话临到他说：
17.en: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,

17.zh: 「你起身往西顿的撒勒法去，住在那里；我已吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。」
17.en: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

17.zh: 以利亚就起身往撒勒法去。到了城门，见有一个寡妇在那里捡柴，以利亚呼叫她说：「求你用器皿取点水来给我喝。」
17.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

17.zh: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又呼叫她说：「也求你拿点饼来给我！」
17.en: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

17.zh: 她说：「我指着永生耶和华—你的　神起誓，我没有饼，坛内只有一把面，瓶里只有一点油；我现在找两根柴，回家要为我和我儿子做[饼]；我们吃了，死就死吧！」
17.en: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

17.zh: 以利亚对她说：「不要惧怕！可以照你所说的去做吧！只要先为我做一个小饼拿来给我，然后为你和你的儿子做饼。
17.en: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

17.zh: 因为耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：坛内的面必不减少，瓶里的油必不缺短，直到耶和华使雨降在地上的日子。」
17.en: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”

17.zh: 妇人就照以利亚的话去行。她和她家中的人，并以利亚，吃了许多日子。
17.en: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

17.zh: 坛内的面果不减少，瓶里的油也不缺短，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。
17.en: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

17.zh: 这事以后，作那家主母的妇人，她儿子病了；病得甚重，以致身无气息。
17.en: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

17.zh: 妇人对以利亚说：「神人哪，我与你何干？你竟到我这里来，使　[神]想念我的罪，以致我的儿子死呢？」
17.en: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

17.zh: 以利亚对她说：「把你儿子交给我。」以利亚就从妇人怀中将孩子接过来，抱到他所住的楼中，放在自己的床上，
17.en: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

17.zh: 就求告耶和华说：「耶和华—我的　神啊，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你就降祸与她，使她的儿子死了吗？」
17.en: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

17.zh: 以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和华说：「耶和华—我的　神啊，求你使这孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体！」
17.en: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

17.zh: 耶和华应允以利亚的话，孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体，他就活了。
17.en: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

17.zh: 以利亚将孩子从楼上抱下来，进屋子交给他母亲，说：「看哪，你的儿子活了！」
17.en: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

17.zh: 妇人对以利亚说：「现在我知道你是神人，耶和华借你口所说的话是真的。」
17.en: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”

18.zh: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说：「你去，使亚哈得见你；我要降雨在地上。」
18.en: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

18.zh: 以利亚就去，要使亚哈得见他。那时，撒马利亚有大饥荒；
18.en: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

18.zh: 亚哈将他的家宰俄巴底召了来。（俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和华，
18.en: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly;

18.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底将一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们。）
18.en: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

18.zh: 亚哈对俄巴底说：「我们走遍这地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪边，或者找得着青草，可以救活骡马，免得绝了牲畜。」
18.en: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

18.zh: 于是二人分地游行，亚哈独走一路，俄巴底独走一路。
18.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

18.zh: 俄巴底在路上恰与以利亚相遇，俄巴底认出他来，就俯伏在地，说：「你是我主以利亚不是？」
18.en: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

18.zh: 回答说：「是。你去告诉你主人说，以利亚[在这里]。」
18.en: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

18.zh: 俄巴底说：「仆人有什么罪，你竟要将我交在亚哈手里，使他杀我呢？
18.en: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

18.zh: 我指着永生耶和华—你的　神起誓，无论哪一邦哪一国，我主都打发人去找你。若说你没有在那里，就必使那邦那国的人起誓说，实在是找不着你。
18.en: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

18.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚[在这里]；
18.en: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

18.zh: 恐怕我一离开你，耶和华的灵就提你到我所不知道的地方去。这样，我去告诉亚哈，他若找不着你，就必杀我；仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。
18.en: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.

18.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，我将耶和华的一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们，岂没有人将这事告诉我主吗？
18.en: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

18.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚[在这里]，他必杀我。」
18.en: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

18.zh: 以利亚说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军之耶和华起誓，我今日必使亚哈得见我。」
18.en: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

18.zh: 于是俄巴底去迎着亚哈，告诉他；亚哈就去迎着以利亚。
18.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

18.zh: 亚哈见了以利亚，便说：「使以色列遭灾的就是你吗？」
18.en: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

18.zh: 以利亚说：「使以色列遭灾的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因为你们离弃耶和华的诫命，去随从巴力。
18.en: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

18.zh: 现在你当差遣人，招聚以色列众人和事奉巴力的那四百五十个先知，并耶洗别所供养事奉亚舍拉的那四百个先知，使他们都上迦密山去见我。」
18.en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

18.zh: 亚哈就差遣人招聚以色列众人和先知都上迦密山。
18.en: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

18.zh: 以利亚前来对众民说：「你们心持两意要到几时呢？若耶和华是　神，就当顺从耶和华；若巴力是　神，就当顺从巴力。」众民一言不答。
18.en: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

18.zh: 以利亚对众民说：「作耶和华先知的只剩下我一个人；巴力的先知却有四百五十个人。
18.en: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

18.zh: 当给我们两只牛犊，巴力的先知可以挑选一只，切成块子，放在柴上，不要点火；我也预备一只牛犊放在柴上，也不点火。
18.en: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

18.zh: 你们求告你们神的名，我也求告耶和华的名。那降火显应的神，就是　神。」众民回答说：「这话甚好。」
18.en: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

18.zh: 以利亚对巴力的先知说：「你们既是人多，当先挑选一只牛犊，预备好了，就求告你们神的名，却不要点火。」
18.en: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

18.zh: 他们将所得的牛犊预备好了，从早晨到午间，求告巴力的名说：「巴力啊，求你应允我们！」却没有声音，没有应允的。他们在所筑的坛四围踊跳。
18.en: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

18.zh: 到了正午，以利亚嬉笑他们，说：「大声求告吧！因为他是神，他或默想，或走到一边，或行路，或睡觉，你们当叫醒他。」
18.en: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

18.zh: 他们大声求告，按着他们的规矩，用刀枪自割、自刺，直到身体流血。
18.en: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

18.zh: 从午后直到献晚祭的时候，他们狂呼乱叫，却没有声音，没有应允的，也没有理会的。
18.en: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

18.zh: 以利亚对众民说：「你们到我这里来。」众民就到他那里。他便重修已经毁坏耶和华的坛。
18.en: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.

18.zh: 以利亚照雅各子孙支派的数目，取了十二块石头（耶和华的话曾临到雅各说：「你的名要叫以色列」），
18.en: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

18.zh: 用这些石头为耶和华的名筑一座坛，在坛的四围挖沟，可容谷种二细亚，
18.en: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

18.zh: 又在坛上摆好了柴，把牛犊切成块子放在柴上，对众人说：「你们用四个桶盛满水，倒在燔祭和柴上」；
18.en: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

18.zh: 又说：「倒第二次。」他们就倒第二次；又说：「倒第三次。」他们就倒第三次。
18.en: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

18.zh: 水流在坛的四围，沟里也满了水。
18.en: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

18.zh: 到了献[晚]祭的时候，先知以利亚近前来，说：「亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的　神，耶和华啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的　神，也知道我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命行这一切事。
18.en: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

18.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，应允我！使这民知道你—耶和华是　神，又知道是你叫这民的心回转。」
18.en: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

18.zh: 于是，耶和华降下火来，烧尽燔祭、木柴、石头、尘土，又烧干沟里的水。
18.en: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

18.zh: 众民看见了，就俯伏在地，说：「耶和华是　神！耶和华是　神！」
18.en: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”

18.zh: 以利亚对他们说：「拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脱！」众人就拿住他们。以利亚带他们到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。
18.en: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

18.zh: 以利亚对亚哈说：「你现在可以上去吃喝，因为有多雨的响声了。」
18.en: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

18.zh: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，将脸伏在两膝之中；
18.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

18.zh: 对仆人说：「你上去，向海观看。」仆人就上去观看，说：「没有什么。」他说：「你再去观看。」如此七次。
18.en: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

18.zh: 第七次仆人说：「我看见有一小片云从海里上来，不过如人手那样大。」以利亚说：「你上去告诉亚哈，当套车下去，免得被雨阻挡。」
18.en: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

18.zh: 霎时间，天因风云黑暗，降下大雨。亚哈就坐车往耶斯列去了。
18.en: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

18.zh: 耶和华的灵降在以利亚身上，他就束上腰，奔在亚哈前头，直到耶斯列的城门。
18.en: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

19.zh: 亚哈将以利亚一切所行的和他用刀杀众先知的事都告诉耶洗别。
19.en: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

19.zh: 耶洗别就差遣人去见以利亚，告诉他说：「明日约在这时候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一样，愿神明重重地降罚与我。」
19.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

19.zh: 以利亚见这光景就起来逃命，到了犹大的别是巴，将仆人留在那里，
19.en: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

19.zh: 自己在旷野走了一日的路程，来到一棵罗腾树下，就坐在那里求死，说：「耶和华啊，罢了！求你取我的性命，因为我不胜于我的列祖。」
19.en: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

19.zh: 他就躺在罗腾树下，睡着了。有一个天使拍他，说：「起来吃吧！」
19.en: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

19.zh: 他观看，见头旁有一瓶水与炭火烧的饼，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。
19.en: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

19.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次来拍他，说：「起来吃吧！因为你当走的路甚远。」
19.en: The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

19.zh: 他就起来吃了喝了，仗着这饮食的力，走了四十昼夜，到了　神的山，就是何烈山。
19.en: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

19.zh: 他在那里进了一个洞，就住在洞中。耶和华的话临到他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」
19.en: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

19.zh: 他说：「我为耶和华—万军之　神大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」
19.en: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

19.zh: 耶和华说：「你出来站在山上，在我面前。」那时耶和华从那里经过，在他面前有烈风大作，崩山碎石，耶和华却不在风中；风后地震，耶和华却不在其中；
19.en: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD.” Behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

19.zh: 地震后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有微小的声音。
19.en: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

19.zh: 以利亚听见，就用外衣蒙上脸，出来站在洞口。有声音向他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」
19.en: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

19.zh: 他说：「我为耶和华—万军之　神大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」
19.en: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

19.zh: 耶和华对他说：「你回去，从旷野往大马士革去。到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王，
19.en: The LORD said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

19.zh: 又膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，并膏亚伯·米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙作先知接续你。
19.en: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

19.zh: 将来躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶户所杀；躲避耶户之刀的，必被以利沙所杀。
19.en: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

19.zh: 但我在以色列人中[为自己]留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾与巴力亲嘴的。」
19.en: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

19.zh: 于是，以利亚离开那里走了，遇见沙法的儿子以利沙耕地；在他前头有十二对[牛]，自己赶着第十二对。以利亚到他那里去，将自己的外衣搭在他身上。
19.en: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

19.zh: 以利沙就离开牛，跑到以利亚那里，说：「求你容我先与父母亲嘴，然后我便跟随你。」以利亚对他说：「你回去吧，我向你做了什么呢？」
19.en: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

19.zh: 以利沙就离开他回去，宰了一对牛，用套牛的器具煮肉给民吃，随后就起身跟随以利亚，服事他。
19.en: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

20.zh: 亚兰王便·哈达聚集他的全军，率领三十二个王，带着车马上来围攻撒马利亚；
20.en: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

20.zh: 又差遣使者进城见以色列王亚哈，对他说：「便·哈达如此说：
20.en: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

20.zh: 你的金银都要归我，你妻子儿女中最美的也要归我。」
20.en: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

20.zh: 以色列王回答说：「我主我王啊，可以依着你的话，我与我所有的都归你。」
20.en: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

20.zh: 使者又来说：「便·哈达如此说：我已差遣人去见你，要你将你的金银、妻子、儿女都给我。
20.en: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

20.zh: 但明日约在这时候，我还要差遣臣仆到你那里，搜查你的家和你仆人的家，将你眼中一切所喜爱的都拿了去。」
20.en: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

20.zh: 以色列王召了国中的长老来，对他们说：「请你们看看，这人是怎样地谋害[我]，他先差遣人到我这里来，要我的妻子、儿女，和金银，我并没有推辞他。」
20.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

20.zh: 长老和百姓对王说：「不要听从他，也不要应允他。」
20.en: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

20.zh: 故此，以色列王对便·哈达的使者说：「你们告诉我主我王说：王头一次差遣人向仆人所要的，仆人都依从；但这次所要的，我不能依从。」使者就去回复便·哈达。
20.en: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

20.zh: 便·哈达又差遣人去见亚哈说：「撒马利亚的尘土若够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的，愿神明重重地降罚与我！」
20.en: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

20.zh: 以色列王说：「你告诉他说，才顶[盔]贯[甲]的，休要像摘[盔]卸[甲]的夸口。」
20.en: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

20.zh: 便·哈达和诸王正在帐幕里喝酒，听见这话，就对他臣仆说：「摆队吧！」他们就摆队攻城。
20.en: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

20.zh: 有一个先知来见以色列王亚哈，说：「耶和华如此说：『这一大群人你看见了吗？今日我必将他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。』」
20.en: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

20.zh: 亚哈说：「借着谁呢？」他回答说：「耶和华说，借着跟从省长的少年人。」亚哈说：「要谁率领呢？」他说：「要你亲自率领。」
20.en: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “The LORD says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

20.zh: 于是亚哈数点跟从省长的少年人，共有二百三十二名，后又数点以色列的众兵，共有七千名。
20.en: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

20.zh: 午间，他们就出城；便·哈达和帮助他的三十二个王正在帐幕里痛饮。
20.en: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

20.zh: 跟从省长的少年人先出城；便·哈达差遣人去[探望]，他们回报说：「有人从撒马利亚出来了。」
20.en: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

20.zh: 他说：「他们若为讲和出来，要活捉他们；若为打仗出来，也要活捉他们。」
20.en: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

20.zh: 跟从省长的少年人出城，军兵跟随他们；
20.en: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

20.zh: 各人遇见敌人就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们；亚兰王便·哈达骑着马和马兵一同逃跑。
20.en: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

20.zh: 以色列王出城攻打车马，大大击杀亚兰人。
20.en: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

20.zh: 那先知来见以色列王，对他说：「你当自强，留心怎样防备；因为到明年这时候，亚兰王必上来攻击你。」
20.en: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

20.zh: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说：「以色列人的神是山神，所以他们胜过我们；但在平原与他们打仗，我们必定得胜。
20.en: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

20.zh: 王当这样行：把诸王革去，派军长代替他们，
20.en: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

20.zh: 又照着王丧失军兵之数，再招募一军，马补马，车补车，我们在平原与他们打仗，必定得胜。」王便听臣仆的话去行。
20.en: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

20.zh: 次年，便·哈达果然点齐亚兰人上亚弗去，要与以色列人打仗。
20.en: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

20.zh: 以色列人也点齐军兵，预备食物，迎着亚兰人出去，对着他们安营，好像两小群山羊羔；亚兰人却满了地面。
20.en: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

20.zh: 有神人来见以色列王，说：「耶和华如此说：『亚兰人既说我—耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我必将这一大群人都交在你手中，你们就知道我是耶和华。』」
20.en: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “The LORD is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.’”

20.zh: 以色列人与亚兰人相对安营七日，到第七日两军交战；那一日以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万，
20.en: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

20.zh: 其余的逃入亚弗城；城墙塌倒，压死剩下的二万七千人。 便·哈达也逃入城，藏在严密的屋子里。
20.en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

20.zh: 他的臣仆对他说：「我们听说以色列王都是仁慈的王，现在我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或者他存留王的性命。」
20.en: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

20.zh: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，去见以色列王，说：「王的仆人便·哈达说，求王存留我的性命。」亚哈说：「他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟。」
20.en: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

20.zh: 这些人留心探出他的口气来，便急忙就着他的话说：「便·哈达是王的兄弟！」王说：「你们去请他来。」便·哈达出来见王，王就请他上车。
20.en: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

20.zh: 便·哈达对王说：「我父从你父那里所夺的城邑，我必归还。你可以在大马士革立街市，像我父在撒马利亚所立的一样。」亚哈说：「我照此立约，放你回去」，就与他立约，放他去了。
20.en: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

20.zh: 有先知的一个门徒奉耶和华的命对他的同伴说：「你打我吧！」那人不肯打他。
20.en: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

20.zh: 他就对那人说：「你既不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，必有狮子咬死你。」那人一离开他，果然遇见狮子，把他咬死了。
20.en: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

20.zh: 先知的门徒又遇见一个人，对他说：「你打我吧！」那人就打他，将他打伤。
20.en: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

20.zh: 他就去了，用头巾蒙眼，改换面目，在路旁等候王。
20.en: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

20.zh: 王从那里经过，他向王呼叫说：「仆人在阵上的时候，有人带了一个人来，对我说：『你看守这人，若把他失了，你的性命必代替他的性命；不然，你必交出一他连得银子来。』
20.en: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

20.zh: 仆人正在忙乱之间，那人就不见了。」以色列王对他说：「你自己定妥了，必照样判断你。」
20.en: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

20.zh: 他急忙除掉蒙眼的头巾，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。
20.en: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

20.zh: 他对王说：「耶和华如此说：『因你将我定要灭绝的人放去，你的命就必代替他的命，你的民也必代替他的民。』」
20.en: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

20.zh: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐地回到撒马利亚，进了他的宫。
20.en: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

21.zh: 这事以后，又有一事。耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒马利亚王亚哈的宫。
21.en: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

21.zh: 亚哈对拿伯说：「你将你的葡萄园给我作菜园，因为是靠近我的宫；我就把更好的葡萄园换给你，或是你要银子，我就按着价值给你。」
21.en: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

21.zh: 拿伯对亚哈说：「我敬畏耶和华，万不敢将我先人留下的产业给你。」
21.en: Naboth said to Ahab, “May the LORD forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

21.zh: 亚哈因耶斯列人拿伯说「我不敢将我先人留下的产业给你」，就闷闷不乐地回宫，躺在床上，转脸向内，也不吃饭。
21.en: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

21.zh: 王后耶洗别来问他说：「你为什么心里这样忧闷，不吃饭呢？」
21.en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

21.zh: 他回答说：「因我向耶斯列人拿伯说：『你将你的葡萄园给我，我给你价银，或是你愿意，我就把[别的]葡萄园换给你』；他却说：『我不将我的葡萄园给你。』」
21.en: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

21.zh: 王后耶洗别对亚哈说：「你现在是治理以色列国不是？只管起来，心里畅畅快快地吃饭，我必将耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。」
21.en: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

21.zh: 于是托亚哈的名写信，用王的印印上，送给那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄。
21.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

21.zh: 信上写着说：「你们当宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上，
21.en: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

21.zh: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯对面，作见证告他说：『你谤渎　神和王了』；随后就把他拉出去用石头打死。」
21.en: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

21.zh: 那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄得了耶洗别的信，就照信而行，
21.en: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

21.zh: 宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上。
21.en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

21.zh: 有两个匪徒来，坐在拿伯的对面，当着众民作见证告他说：「拿伯谤渎　神和王了！」众人就把他拉到城外，用石头打死。
21.en: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

21.zh: 于是打发人去见耶洗别，说：「拿伯被石头打死了。」
21.en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

21.zh: 耶洗别听见拿伯被石头打死，就对亚哈说：「你起来得耶斯列人拿伯不肯为价银给你的葡萄园吧！现在他已经死了。」
21.en: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

21.zh: 亚哈听见拿伯死了，就起来，下去要得耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园。
21.en: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

21.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
21.en: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

21.zh: 「你起来，去见住撒马利亚的以色列王亚哈，他下去要得拿伯的葡萄园，现今正在那园里。
21.en: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

21.zh: 你要对他说：『耶和华如此说：你杀了人，又得他的产业吗？』又要对他说：『耶和华如此说：狗在何处舔拿伯的血，也必在何处舔你的血。』」
21.en: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

21.zh: 亚哈对以利亚说：「我仇敌啊，你找到我吗？」他回答说：「我找到你了；因为你卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。
21.en: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.

21.zh: [耶和华说]：『我必使灾祸临到你，将你除尽。凡属你的男丁，无论困住的、自由的，都从以色列中剪除。
21.en: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

21.zh: 我必使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家；因为你惹我发怒，又使以色列人陷在罪里。』
21.en: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

21.zh: 论到耶洗别，耶和华也说：『狗在耶斯列的外郭必吃耶洗别的肉。
21.en: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

21.zh: 凡属亚哈的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。』」 （
21.en: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

21.zh: 从来没有像亚哈的，因他自卖，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，受了王后耶洗别的耸动；
21.en: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

21.zh: 就照耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的亚摩利人，行了最可憎恶的事，信从偶像。）
21.en: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

21.zh: 亚哈听见这话，就撕裂衣服，禁食，身穿麻布，睡卧也穿着麻布，并且缓缓而行。
21.en: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

21.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
21.en: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

21.zh: 「亚哈在我面前这样自卑，你看见了吗？因他在我面前自卑，他还在世的时候，我不降这祸；到他儿子的时候，我必降这祸与他的家。」
21.en: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

22.zh: 亚兰国和以色列国三年没有争战。
22.en: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

22.zh: 到第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。
22.en: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

22.zh: 以色列王对臣仆说：「你们不知道基列的拉末是属我们的吗？我们岂可静坐不动，不从亚兰王手里夺回来吗？」
22.en: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

22.zh: 亚哈问约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」约沙法对以色列王说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」
22.en: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

22.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」
22.en: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”

22.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知，约有四百人，问他们说：「我上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为主必将那城交在王的手里。」
22.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

22.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」
22.en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?”

22.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅，我们可以托他求问耶和华。只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」
22.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

22.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去，将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」
22.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

22.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服，坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
22.en: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

22.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」
22.en: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

22.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
22.en: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

22.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅 说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」
22.en: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

22.zh: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，耶和华对我说什么，我就说什么。」
22.en: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”

22.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他回答说：「可以上去，必然得胜，耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
22.en: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

22.zh: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」
22.en: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

22.zh: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」
22.en: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

22.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语单说凶言吗？」
22.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

22.zh: 米该雅说：「你要听耶和华的话！我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
22.en: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word. I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

22.zh: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。
22.en: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

22.zh: 随后有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：『我去引诱他。』
22.en: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

22.zh: 耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』
22.en: The LORD said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

22.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」
22.en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

22.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来，打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」
22.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

22.zh: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」
22.en: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

22.zh: 以色列王说：「将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说
22.en: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

22.zh: 王如此说，把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。」
22.en: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

22.zh: 米该雅说：「你若能平平安安地回来，那就是耶和华没有借我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」
22.en: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

22.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
22.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

22.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」以色列王就改装上阵。
22.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

22.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐他的三十二个车兵长说：「他们的[兵将]，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」
22.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

22.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法，便说：「这必是以色列王！」就转过去与他争战，约沙法便呼喊。
22.en: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

22.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。
22.en: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

22.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」
22.en: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

22.zh: 那日，阵势越战越猛，有人扶王站在车上，抵挡亚兰人。到晚上，王就死了，血从伤处流在车中。
22.en: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

22.zh: 约在日落的时候，有号令传遍军中，说：「各归本城，各归本地吧！」
22.en: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

22.zh: 王既死了，众人将他送到撒马利亚，就葬在那里；
22.en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

22.zh: 又有人把他的车洗在撒马利亚的池旁（妓女[在那里]洗澡），狗来舔他的血，正如耶和华所说的话。
22.en: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.

22.zh: 亚哈其余的事，凡他所行的和他所修造的象牙宫，并所建筑的一切城邑，都写在以色列诸王记上。
22.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

22.zh: 亚哈与他列祖同睡。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。
22.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

22.zh: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作了犹大王。
22.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

22.zh: 约沙法登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。
22.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

22.zh: 约沙法行他父亲亚撒所行的道，不偏离左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事；只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
22.en: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

22.zh: 约沙法与以色列王和好。
22.en: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

22.zh: 约沙法其余的事和他所显出的勇力，并他怎样争战，都写在犹大列王记上。
22.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

22.zh: 约沙法将他父亲亚撒在世所剩下的娈童都从国中除去了。
22.en: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

22.zh: 那时以东没有王，有总督治理。
22.en: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

22.zh: 约沙法制造他施船只，要往俄斐去，将金子运来；只是没有去，因为船在以旬·迦别破坏了。
22.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

22.zh: 亚哈的儿子亚哈谢对约沙法说：「容我的仆人和你的仆人坐船同去吧！」约沙法却不肯。
22.en: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

22.zh: 约沙法与列祖同睡。葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。
22.en: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

22.zh: 犹大王约沙法十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒马利亚登基，作以色列王共二年。
22.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

22.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他的父母，又行尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的 事。
22.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

22.zh: 他照他父亲一切所行的，事奉敬拜巴力，惹耶和华—以色列　神的怒气。
22.en: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
